summary: Clappy's open mouth keeps its bottom outline when he grins

outro.headline: REVIEW THE MOUTH LAYERS
outro.subtitle: Fill, tongue, then ink in Mouth, web and Expo

pane.title: The tongue covers the ink
pane.desc: On the grin the tongue is painted over the mouth's bottom edge, so the outline vanishes and pink spills below.

pane.title: The outline is drawn last
pane.desc: A smaller tongue sits inside the mouth and the ink goes on top, so the bottom edge stays closed.
